prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square mobile RPG mage active skill icon, Ice Time, Wordoria Crystal Quest.
Primary request: A single youthful mage hand held palm-up, with a radiant ice crystal floating clearly ABOVE the open palm. The icy crystal emits bright cyan-white and mint magical light reflected on the fingers. Make the palm and the gap of air below the crystal unmistakable.
Style/medium: 밝은 하이엔드 모바일 RPG용 2D 애니메이션 판타지 일러스트. 선명하고 큰 실루엣, 깨끗한 셀 셰이딩 위에 부드러운 채색 그라데이션, 보랏빛·푸른빛의 투명 크리스털, 민트 마법광, 절제된 금장, 젊고 용감한 표정, 읽기 쉬운 형태를 사용한다. Clean anime linework and polished soft cel painting; premium collectible fantasy skill icon.
Composition: square 1:1 full-bleed icon. Large faceted icy-blue crystal at upper center, elegantly cupped open hand across lower center, wrist emerging from bottom right in a white and violet mage sleeve with small restrained gold cuff. Exactly one hand, five natural fingers. Crystal is the brightest focal point, fills about 40 percent of canvas height; hand about 35 percent. A few crisp ice sparkles and a subtle thin magical light ring beneath the crystal emphasize levitation. Preserve clear silhouette when reduced to 48px.
Frame/backdrop: rounded square polished violet crystal border with thin gold inner trim, matching a casual high-end fantasy skill icon set. Deep indigo-violet interior to contrast the luminous cyan ice. Restrained decoration; no words or labels.
Palette: Crystal Violet #5751D8, Night Violet #24214C, cyan ice, mint #60D9CF, white light, restrained Treasure Gold #FFCF67.
Avoid: pixel art, photorealism, gritty realism, 3D plastic render, extra hands or fingers, staff, face, full character, text, letters, watermark, complex tiny details, blurred silhouette. Deliver ONE finished square icon, no presentation board.
concept: 손 위에 빛나는 얼음 결정체가 떠 있는 아이스 타임
review: Generated image visually reviewed; integrated into the existing skill button.
